People: James Daniel Richardson (editor, Wikidata Q1680243), died 1914. They are every person Project Gutenberg's catalog lists for the book ("Richardson, James D. (James Daniel), 1843-1914 [Editor]") and every person the printed edition's opening pages credit; each death year is Wikidata's.

Printed edition: A compilation of the messages and papers of the presidents, [New York] Bureau of national literature, 1911, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/acompilationmes01statgoog. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 100%, 93%, 88% of their four-word runs in the scan's text. The scan does not show the credit of James Daniel Richardson, whom the catalog lists; the passages show the scan holds this text.
